headlines.title: Kevin Reddington: Lindsay Clancy wants her babies
headlines.description: In his sit-down interview with NBC News’ Laura Jarrett, Kevin Reddington, the defense attorney for Lindsay Clancy, says the woman who's living amongst us is the person that everybody loved and “the person that committed this atrocious act was as a result of postpartum psychosis combined with the medications that she was provided.”

headlines.title: Apple announces first foldable iPhone at annual event
headlines.description: In his first event as Apple CEO, John Ternus announced the first foldable iPhone, marking the biggest change to the iPhone since it was introduced in 2007. Apple said the iPhone Duo would sell for a base price of $1,999. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Missouri court opens contempt probe into Republican official over redistricting fight
headlines.description: The no-holds-barred fight over congressional maps in Missouri has reached a new level of intensity with the state’s high court opening a contempt probe into Secretary of State Denny Hoskins.

headlines.title: US Destroys 5 Iranian Oil Tankers as War Escalates Once Again
headlines.description: The United States struck five Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman following an attack on an American warship by Iran. Now, the growing tensions are triggering yet another major spike in oil and gas prices. It comes as President Donald Trump is threatening to ban some food and alcohol imports from Canada. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Rhode Island primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Rhode Island, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Trump admin fires prosecutor in dropped case against politically-linked billionaire
headlines.description: A federal prosecutor who had been assigned to the now-defunct case against a politically-linked Indian billionaire has been fired by the Trump administration, two people familiar with the firing tell NBC News.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy rejects conspiracy theories accusing her ex of their children’s deaths, lawyer says
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy rejects the internet conspiracy theories accusing her ex-husband of killing their three children in 2023 and believes he has been unfairly targeted by online sleuths since her murder trial, her defense attorney Kevin Reddington told NBC News on Wednesday in a wide-ranging interview.

headlines.title: John Malkovich cancels Tel Aviv show after promoter fabricates statement from him on Israel
headlines.description: John Malkovich cancelled a show in Tel Aviv after learning The Jerusalem Post unknowingly published a made-up a quote about his “solidarity” with Israeli audiences.

headlines.title: Jalen Brunson to host ‘SNL’ season 52 premiere hot off of Knicks championship
headlines.description: It’s nothing but net for “Saturday Night Live” later this month as the show announced that New York’s own Jalen Brunson will be the first host for the show’s 52nd season.

headlines.title: Tate brothers denied bail by Miami judge as they fight extradition to U.K. on sex crime charges
headlines.description: A judge denied bail for Andrew and Tristan Tate, the “manosphere” influencers who’ll now have to remain behind bars in Florida while fighting extradition to the U.K. on dozens of sex crime charges.

headlines.title: Apple announces long-awaited foldable phone, iPhone Duo
headlines.description: Apple’s first foldable phone capped a day of product announcements that also included the new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

headlines.title: Wife of man killed when Amazon-branded plane overran runway files wrongful death lawsuit
headlines.description: The wife of one of the victims killed when an Amazon-branded plane overran a runway at a Miami airport, striking an airline cleaning service van and a passenger SUV, has filed a wrongful death lawsuit.
